WITH filtered_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    t.MediaTypeId,
    mt.Name,
    t.UnitPrice,
    CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL(20,2)) / t.Milliseconds as bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
),
media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    Name,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price,
    AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM filtered_tracks
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId, Name
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as overall_avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM filtered_tracks
)
SELECT 
  mts.Name,
  mts.avg_unit_price,
  mts.avg_bytes_per_ms,
  mts.avg_bytes_per_ms / oa.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms as ratio_to_overall
FROM media_type_stats mts
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE oa.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL
